scope: One ordinary DHCPREQUEST per initial hostsdir mode; real restored-lease helper execution, resolver FIFO DHCP gate, and ordinary hosts diagnostics/name-publication regression. This timing is ordering evidence, not a performance comparison.
source_basis: dnsmasq.c:1264 consumes EVENT_INIT before dhcp_packet at 1319.
EVENT_INIT at dnsmasq.c:1575 calls clear_cache_and_reload; dnsmasq.c:1839 calls cache_reload.
cache.c:1719 calls set_dynamic_inotify(AH_HOSTS); inotify.c:253 reads the initial regular hostsdir files synchronously.
Rust files_initializing now includes the existing initial bulk scan state (hosts_bulk && !hosts_full_reload); runtime full reload and ordinary file ownership remain distinct.
